## 05 Error handler
Every other workflow points here (settings.errorWorkflow). Failures are stored in the errors table with the workflow, the failing node and the message, and optionally posted to a Slack-compatible webhook. The dashboard shows the count.

parameters.query: insert into errors (workflow, node, message, payload) values ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb) returning id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [String(($json.workflow && $json.workflow.name) || ''), String(($json.execution && $json.execution.lastNodeExecuted) || ''), String(($json.execution && $json.execution.error && $json.execution.error.message) || ($json.trigger && $json.trigger.error && $json.trigger.error.message) || 'unknown error').slice(0, 1000), JSON.stringify({ workflow: $json.workflow, execution: $json.execution ? { id: $json.execution.id, url: $json.execution.url, mode: $json.execution.mode, lastNodeExecuted: $json.execution.lastNodeExecuted, error: $json.execution.error ? { name: $json.execution.error.name, message: $json.execution.error.message, description: $json.execution.error.description } : null } : null, trigger: $json.trigger ? { error: $json.trigger.error ? { name: $json.trigger.error.name, message: $json.trigger.error.message } : null } : null })] }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: 'lead-pipeline error in ' + String(($('Error trigger').first().json.workflow && $('Error trigger').first().json.workflow.name) || '?') + ' at node ' + String(($('Error trigger').first().json.execution && $('Error trigger').first().json.execution.lastNodeExecuted) || '?') }) }}
